trends.name: Iran War Escalation & Oil Volatility
trends.summary: Iran conflict enters fifth week with Saudi Arabia intercepting 10 drones and Israel warning Tehran strikes. Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain privately urging Trump to continue war despite Iran's claim of fuel supply stability. Trump assessing 4-6 week timeline but willing to negotiate without reopening Hormuz. Direct impact: oil at 5-week highs, gasoline hitting $4/gallon (highest since 2022), and Asian currencies weakening on global recession fears.

trends.name: Energy Cost Crisis in Asia
trends.summary: South Korea proposing $17B emergency budget to cushion energy costs from Iran war. China's manufacturing PMI rebounded to 50.4 (above estimates) suggesting resilience despite energy headwinds. However, credit risk in Asia poised for biggest monthly spike since 2023, signaling stress building beneath surface. Iran's attacks on aluminum producers sending shockwaves through metals market.

trends.name: Global Recession Risk Escalating
trends.summary: Wall Street's 2026 banner year expectations now replaced by recession avoidance focus. US stocks faring worse than during past geopolitical shocks with ample downside room remaining. Asian currencies weakening as oil-driven inflation stokes global outlook fears. SPY down 7.1% YTD while bonds relatively flat, signaling flight to safety.

trends.name: Trump's War Timeline & Diplomatic Shift
trends.summary: Trump telling aides he's willing to end Iran war without reopening Hormuz, prioritizing uranium enrichment over Strait control. Assessment that full Strait reopening pushes conflict beyond 4-6 week timeline. Netanyahu says present priority is Iran's enriched uranium, not Hormuz closure. This diplomatic opening creating market relief rally in oil but uncertainty around lasting peace.

trends.name: Memory Chip Market Collapse
trends.summary: DDR5 DRAM prices fallen nearly 30% over concerns Google's TurboQuant algorithm will cut memory requirements. Chinese retail shops calling it a 'price collapse' with market shifting from shortage fears to wait-and-see attitude. Major negative for semiconductor memory manufacturers; Software outperformed Semiconductors by 500bps today—rare event suggesting sector rotation.

trends.name: Commodity Price Surge & China Supply Chains
trends.summary: Three niche commodity prices surging, revealing China's firm grip on critical supply chains. Iran attacks on aluminum producers sending shockwaves; copper miners face energy delivery and supply chain uncertainty. Highlights vulnerability of commodity-dependent economies and China's strategic position in rare earth/specialty materials.

trends.name: China Economic Recovery & AI Race
trends.summary: China's factory activity returns to growth with Manufacturing PMI at 50.4, sharpest pace in a year. Non-Manufacturing PMI 50.1 and Composite 50.5 signal broad-based recovery despite energy headwinds. Simultaneously, China's AI race enters new phase with tech companies prioritizing AI infrastructure. China-Kenya rail project partnership reinforces Belt & Road focus amid geopolitical fragmentation.

trends.name: Defense Sector Beneficiaries
trends.summary: General Dynamics positioned to benefit from high volume of government contracts amid Iran conflict. Defense spending ramping as US maintains military posture. Pete Hegseth's broker attempted defense investments before Iran war escalation. Increased geopolitical risk supporting long-term defense contractor valuations.

trends.name: Biotech & Small-Cap Earnings Season
trends.summary: PepGen (PEPG) reported favorable Phase II FREEDOM2 study data with positive safety and splicing outcomes. Iovance Biotherapeutics facing new competition but new indications can help. Small-cap growth segment (Janus Henderson Q4 2025) showing selective opportunities despite broader market weakness. Merger/acquisition activity possible in biotech given valuations.

trends.name: Dividend & Value Rotation Signals
trends.summary: Johnson & Johnson characterized as 'Return of the Dividend King,' signaling investors rotating to dividend payers amid volatility. Bond ETFs (FLXR) showing outstanding risk-return profiles in uncertain macro environment. Short sellers reversing early 2026 losses with mid-March surge, suggesting volatility creating opportunities for tactical positioning.

trends.name: Consumer Spending Headwinds & Structural Changes
trends.summary: Most people already received tax refunds—bad news for restaurants and retailers dependent on refund spending cycles. Yankees TV rights hitting $1,200+ annually signals media inflation and consumer pushback on sports content pricing. Indicates consumer budget pressure and shifting spending patterns despite resilient employment data.

trends.name: Food Service & Retail Consolidation
trends.summary: Sysco pursuing $29B cash-and-carry business buyout to consolidate fragmented food service sector. BJ's Wholesale Club downgraded to Hold for near-term. Hillman Solutions showing market share gains and pricing power amid uncertainty. Consolidation trends suggest scale becoming more important as energy costs and inflation pressure margins.
